subject: general
question: Which city topped the list of India’s most women-friendly cities for 2025 in Avtar’s Top Cities for Women in India report?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Bengaluru retained its top position as India’s most women-friendly city in Avtar’s Top Cities for Women in India 2025 report.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Bengaluru ranked number one with the highest City Inclusion Score in 2025.**
 
• It was followed by Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad and Mumbai in the top five.
 
• The ranking is based on Social Inclusion Score and Industrial Inclusion Score.
 
• City Inclusion Score__ 
 __
 
• Measures women’s participation, safety and career continuity
 
• Combines social and industrial inclusion indicators
 
• Used to rank 125 Indian cities
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Avtar__

 __
 
• A workplace consulting firm that publishes the Top Cities for Women in India report.
 
 
 
• Social Inclusion Score__
 __
 
• Evaluates safety, liveability, public services, mobility and access to health and education for women.
 
 
 
• Industrial Inclusion Score__
 __
 
• Measures workplace participation, representation and availability of women-friendly industries.
 
 
 
• Tier-2 Cities__
 
 
• Mid-sized Indian cities whose growing inclusion indicates decentralisation of women-friendly ecosystems.
